findings.evidence: `IntegratedEnergyForm.lean:256` introduces `variable [DecidableEq n]`; only `norm_energyFormIntegral_le_of_bounds` at line 328 has `omit [DecidableEq n]`, while the affected theorem signatures at lines 343, 359, 377, 415, 430, and 447 contain no `(1 : Matrix n n ℝ)` or equality-dependent data.
findings.fix: Restrict the `[DecidableEq n]` variable to the shifted-Laplacian/model perturbation lemmas, and add `omit [DecidableEq n] in` to the later Gårding/coercivity integral lemmas, generalizing the pointwise helpers if Lean requires it.
findings.issue: `[DecidableEq n]` from line 256 is unnecessarily required by the non-model integrated estimates `garding_energyFormIntegral_self_of_bounds`, `garding_energyFormIntegral_self_of_mass_lower_bound_of_bounds`, `integral_min_coercivityConstant_mul_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_self_of_bounds`, and the three `UniformlyEllipticOn.*_on` wrappers at lines 415, 430, and 447; these statements mention only raw coefficient bounds/`UniformlyEllipticOn` and no identity matrix or equality test on `n`.

summary: The integrated energy form is mostly at the expected raw-jet level, but the identity-matrix instance scope leaks into later estimates that do not use equality on the index type.
